verse: etat sadrūpaṃ deveśi kathitaṃ tava bhārgaśam | gopayed yonivad yatnādaguptād narakaṃ bhavet
etad varṇaṃ mahākālaṃ prathamaṃ sarvakāmadam | sṛṣṭicakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavanāśanam
kālasya jananī sā vai suśāntā caṇḍacakragā | asyāḥ svarūpagā kālī madhyame ca yathāśritā
mantrāṇāṃ paramārthena bhūmayaḥ satatoditāḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhyuddiṣṭena karmaṇā
avyakte acyute brahme parame viśvarūpake | sākāre tu nirākāre sarvākāre namo'stu te
tāsāṃ jñānaṃ yathā mantro  melāpaṃ tu mahāmate ||2/23 ||
saṃhāraṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | khecarīcakracāreṇa samayāṃ cārayet sadā
sthiti navamavarṇena śilayā lāṃcchitaṃ kuru | etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ rudra ādau tasmāt samuddharet
melāpe militā sā vai manane paramā citiḥ | (11) pītā svasya samastasya ādyā yā bodhakī daśā
devaiścabrahma viṣṇvādyaiḥ pūjayet tu nekāntakam | eṣasaṃhāro deveśa sṛṣṭicakrasya sarvataḥ
idaṃ praśnavaraṃ rudra akathyaṃ sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 44 ||
śrībhairava uvāca devi tvaṃ parameśāni guhyaṃ guhyataraṃ śubham | pṛcchāmi parayā bhaktyā bāhyaṃ guhyamidaṃ param
nirāvakāśa śabdantu prakāśakastathāśiva | sṛṣṭiśvarī tato yojya prathamaṃ piṇḍarāṭ tataḥ
sthiticakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ śaktirūpakam | saṃhārasyāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭametaddhi duḥsaham
prāñjalipraṇatāḥ sarve agrasthāḥ kiṃ prayojanam | etadanugrahād devi vada me parameśvari
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sadyaḥ krameṇānena bhairava | etad vai kathitaṃ vīra kramasyodbhāvanirṇayam
3/ khadaṇḍe tu adaṇḍā sā daṇḍāṇḍādaṇḍarūpiṇī | khadaṇḍādaṇḍayormadhye svaraśmigasaṃvartinī
2/? parabhāvamanudīptā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | antaḥ sūkṣmā bahiḥ sūkṣmā carate yā carācare
kramaṃ tu paramaṃ dhāma labhyate tatkṣaṇādapi | siddhiyogini divyaṃ vai ka* *? bhāvya yatnataḥ | pāramparyakramāyātaṃ mukhādmukhagataṃ mahat
ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśage cakre parā sā bhairavīdaśā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
yoginyo vyomagāḥ sarvāḥ dvādaśagāḥ samāsataḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi aṣṭau devyo vibhāgaśaḥ
vādye tu pratipadyartha pūjāsarvārthadāyakī | kathayāmi tava snehād bhāvamāsena tāṃ śṛṇu
melāpe militā sā vai jñānasya paramā citiḥ | (12) etāstu kathitā devyaḥ melāpe yāḥ khamārgagāḥ
pūrvādi nāgajākrāntaṃ īśānāntamanukramam | nyamuvyāni suraśreṣṭha bhāsārūpāṇyarāsu yat
eṣā vidyā tu mūrtināṃ sarvasvaṃ kālikākrame | tataḥ saṃjñā prakartavyā guruṇocchinnakarmaṇā
tasyāḥ sthānaṃ tu bhāvajña asthānaṃ sthānameva ca | pūjā tasyāstabhāvautthā indriyārthasya preraṇāt
namo'stu devi ādau ca madhye tubhyaṃ namo'stu te | etat stutipadaṃ kṛtvā tathedaṃ vākyamabravīt
śavarī kramadūtī ca khecakre śaktipuṣkale | pūjayet tāṃ vidhānena tato vidyāṃ prapūjayet
āpyāyakāriṇi tataḥ proktaṃ tat tu vicakṣaṇaḥ | sthitiśabdastatodhṛtya bodhaśabdaṃ tataḥ param
tārasvaṃ gṛdhvāntaṃ sā vai * tarā sarvadehinām | ekānekatayā bhinnā abhedī bhinnabhāvanī
saṃsthitā vīravīreśa daśasaptākṣarāntarā | kādyāntā ca kalāṅkasthā kālikā kālakālikā
samayāṃ pūrayed rudra bāhyato vīranāyaka | gurupaṃktiryathārthato ādau pūjyā suyatnataḥ
mattagandhakavāhasthe'aapānarūpe namo'stu te | ṣaṭcakravarjite kāli cakrānteśi namo'stu te
sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi daśamaṃ taṃ viduḥ priye | saṃhārāṣṭaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭiaṣṭamasaṃyutam
pānāni bahave dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet | śavāsanastho vīrendro yoginī vātha suvrataḥ
melāpe militā sā vai sparśasya paramā citiḥ | (2) cakṣurmadhye sthitā yā vai candrārkadvayabhāsakī
etāstu * *? tā devyaḥ sarvagrasanalampaṭāḥ | catvāra urmayo devyāḥ śāṃbhavyudadhimadhyagāḥ
sthiticakrasya bhāvajña dvitīyaṃsvasvarūpakam | sṛṣṭidvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ kuru vīrendranāyakam
aṣṭau devyastu yāḥ proktāḥ yoginīyogacakragāḥ | śāktamārgena saṃprāptāḥ khecaratvagatirdhruvam
sṛṣṭicakrasya ādau tu ṣoḍaśāni samāsataḥ | varṇāni kālakāmāntu pūrvādīśānaka kramāt
kecid vallanti nādanti kecid bhāvarasākulaiḥ | keci nṛtyanti gāyanti vādyanti cakre pūṭitaḥ
kharaṇḍāṇḍe mahācaṇḍā caṇḍatejaḥsvarūpiṇī | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
kuṃdayāgavibhāgeṣu (?) yoginīnāṃ tu sarvataḥ | tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena bhavabandhanisūdana
sarvabhāveṣu laṃpatyā yā vṛttiḥ sarvatomukhī | tasyā madhyasthabhāvena sasphurāstāsnathādhakā (?)
tadājñā vartamāneha bhūtvā kramamidaṃ mahat | pūjyāḥ sarvārthadā nityāḥ śuddhā yā pādabhāvagāḥ | tāstu devyo mahādevyo mūrtayaśca prakīrtitāḥ
mahābhairavamekaṃ tu samurcchaṃ  tiṣṭhate tu yat  ||1/ 66 ||
asya bāhye tu vai rudra padmaṃ paścāt vicakṣaṇaḥ | ālikhyet tu punardivyaiścakraṃ cakravaraṃ mahat
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa vidhānataḥ | vidyā tāsāṃ tu siddhānāṃ devīnāṃ ca yaśasvinī
vidmaheti padaṃ paścāt kālīśabdamataḥ param | tatastu saṃhaṃrṣa vidmeṣa dhāmahomiṣakaṃ tataḥ
siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ tu svarūpapadadarśakī | tataḥ saṃjñā prakartavyā ante pāde nirodhayet
